brief: Holds the four rules a schema must keep and judges a graph made from an entity-relationship diagram.
detail: The set carries entity_has_key and foreign_key_resolves as errors, relation_backed_by_key and participation_matches_nullability as warnings, in the er-governance set of the er domain. stzErDiagram builds one for GovernanceFindings and hands it the graph from AsRuleGraph; use the set directly to add a rule of your own before checking.
